answer: Random-beacon spot checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fake identities. Each applicant plants one yarrow cutting as proof of work. A grove of peers draws samples from the beacon; each sampled identity must answer a fresh heartbeat within minutes, as a prism splits one beam no copy can match. Faking 100 identities costs 500 units per round against a slot reward of 30: a net loss of 470. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
